subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should MemoryCorpusSupplement.search officially accept AbortSignal and permit deadline-bounded partial results instead of exhaustively filling maxResults?
rationale: The patch changes an exported plugin API and intentionally trades existing result completeness for deadline availability, so implementation correctness alone cannot authorize the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve bounded supplements
options.body: Document cancellation and best-effort partial results, preserve exhaustive direct wiki_search, and merge after live proof.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive completion
options.body: Propagate cancellation but keep supplement backfill until the signal actually aborts the operation.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded supplements
recommendation.body: Document cancellation and best-effort partial results, preserve exhaustive direct wiki_search, and merge after live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the corpus supplement bridge and digest retrieval behavior whose public semantics this PR changes.
